We've all had those family group chats where we share tips and tricks for being ready for anything life throws our way. 🌟 One resource we find super helpful is a guide that covers essential safety skills for emergencies. It's like a friendly reminder of simple things we can all do to feel a bit more prepared without the stress. Taking a little time to learn and discuss these skills together can make a big difference for our loved ones. 

What’s a safety tip or trick you’ve shared with your family lately?
